name: Plenoxels regularization ablation
definition: Uses Total Variation (TV) regularization on opacity ($\sigma$) and spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients, plus a sparsity loss, to prevent visual artifacts and control memory usage during optimization.
summary: Plenoxels regularization ablation stabilizes sparse voxel optimization by combining Total Variation on opacities and spherical harmonics with sparsity and beta losses to prevent artifacts and reduce memory usage.
